Title: General availability: Run Enterprise Java with Red Hat JBoss EAP for Azure Virtual Machines

Body.Content:
These new Azure Marketplace offers provide solutions to customers who want to move off expensive, proprietary solutions, eliminate the need for on-premises data centers, and preserve existing Java EE / Jakarta EE investments while moving to more flexible open-source solutions and providing. These offers provide integration with Azure and increased reliability and availability of workloads. The substantial support resources from both Microsoft and Red Hat are available.

See the QuickStart guidance.

Learn more.
